description: This file defines an immutable Java class 'ImmutableInfoProvider' which implements the 'ConnectionMonitor.InfoProvider' interface. The class provides read-only access to various connection monitoring details such as correlation ID, timestamp, thing ID, headers, payload, and an 'isEmpty' flag. It encapsulates information used within the connection monitoring infrastructure of the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ImmutableInfoProvider
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the ConnectionMonitor.InfoProvider interface, providing read-only access to connection monitoring information such as correlation ID, timestamp, thing ID, headers, payload, and empty status.

methods.name: getCorrelationId
methods.description: Returns the correlation ID associated with the connection info.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp indicating when the info was captured.

methods.name: getThingId
methods.description: Returns the optional ThingId associated with the info, if any.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Returns the headers map associated with the info.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Returns the payload string by invoking the payload supplier.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Indicates if the info object is considered empty.

calls: Objects.hash(correlationId, timestamp, thingId, headers, payloadSupplier, isEmpty)
